Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that Vice Admiral Kakuji Kakuta was in charge of the Carrier Division containing the Japanese carrier Hiyō when she was sunk. The Predicted Answer, however, states that Rear Admiral Takaji Joshima commanded Carrier Division 2 (which Hiyō was part of) and also mentions Vice Admiral Jisaburō Ozawa as commander of the overall fleet, but does not mention Vice Admiral Kakuji Kakuta at all. Thus, the specific information in the Ground Truth Answer is not present in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
